title: I Challenged a Pro VFX Artist to a Duel (AI vs Reality)
description: I challenged ErikDoesVFX to a head-to-head: same brief, two pipelines. Then I went further and built a $50,000 dragon sequence from scratch in one day, with no footage at all. Every shot was generated with Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield AI - character replacement with video-to-video, photoreal creature animation, full CG water and cloud physics, all from prompts written in Claude. You'll learn the complete workflow: building character sheets that lock your face across generations, fixing scale with size-fit frames, spotting slop before it wastes your credits, and directing real emotion in AI actors. No greenscreen, no 3D software, no VFX experience needed.
